executive_summary: NanoCore Semiconductor cleanroom fire creates an immediate Tier-1 disruption for microcontrollers, resulting in production halt exposure at Munich Plant 1.
root_cause_analysis: A localized cleanroom electrical fire at Hsinchu Fab 2 contaminated photolithography steppers, halting manufacturing of MCU-X91 automotive controllers.
operational_impact: Munich assembly plant currently holds 7.68 days of cover against a 9.0-day revised supplier ETA, creating an unbuffered 1.32-day coverage gap of 24,420 units.
runway_and_exposure_commentary: Direct inventory shortage yields $2,448,105.00 component exposure; line halt exposure at €85,000/hr yields €2,692,800.00 total operational vulnerability.

citations.verbatim_quote: Usable stock 142,000 units against daily burn rate of 18,500 units.
Cleanroom fire at NanoCore facility halted production with estimated 9-day recovery timeline.
